in_hebrew.name: מויס
in_hebrew.long_meaning: From the Hebrew verb וויס (yasat) which means ‘to draw out, to rescue, to deliver from danger.’

in_greek.name: Μωυσης
in_greek.long_meaning: From the Greek Μωυσης (Mōusēs), derived from the Egyptian mose ‘delivered’ or ‘son.’

in_latin.name: Mosēs
in_latin.long_meaning: From the Latin Mosēs, derived from the Greek Μωυσης (Mōusēs).
